jobs.occupation: Systems Engineer Exploration, Space Safety and Space Transportation (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

In this role, you will be responsible for the holistic systems engineering of complex space missions, from early concept phases through to verification. You will analyze customer, mission and system requirements and translate them into structured specifications, including the development of functional architectures and identification of required adaptations.

A key part of your work will involve the derivation and management of requirements down to subsystem and equipment level using DOORS, as well as supporting trade-offs and shaping the overall mission and system architecture. You will actively contribute to the design and development of space systems, covering everything from mission analysis to subsystem specifications.

You will coordinate technical activities across subsystems and internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment in case of requirement changes and assessing their impact. In addition, you will act as a key interface to subcontractors (on behalf of the Project Chief Engineer or Project Manager) as well as to external partners, including industry and ESA.

Your responsibilities also include supporting system design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR), verification planning and the monitoring of requirement compliance. You will contribute to defining verification strategies, preparing test specifications and evaluating test results. Furthermore, you will support the implementation of design changes (e.g. RFWs, RFDs, NCRs) and contribute to the preparation of proposals for future exploration missions.
Your Qualifications

You hold a degree (Diploma or Master) in aerospace engineering or a comparable qualification and bring a solid foundation in systems engineering. You have experience in requirements analysis, specification development and the definition of system architectures, ideally complemented by knowledge of interface management.

Practical experience in areas such as exploration, space safety or space transportation is a strong asset. Beyond your technical expertise, you demonstrate strong communication skills and feel comfortable working in international, interdisciplinary teams within structured project environments.

Your strengths include creativity, a solution-oriented mindset and the ability to navigate complex challenges effectively.

You are confident communicating in English; German language skills are an advantage.

jobs.occupation: FP&A Senior Controller  - SG&A / all genders / Part-Fulltime (Controller/in)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Everything we do in Electronics is to help us deliver on our purpose of being the company behind the companies, advancing digital living. We are dedicated to being the trusted supplier of high-tech materials, services and specialty chemicals for the electronics, automotive and cosmetics industries. We foster a global collaborative organization made up of individuals who have the passion to win, obsess about the customer, are relentlessly curious and act with urgency. Together, we push the boundaries of science to make more possible for our customers.

Your role:

As Senior Controller FP&A, you will act as a trusted business partner to the Electronics Leadership Team and serve as the functional CFO for SG&A. You will provide fact-based financial analysis that enables timely, well-informed decisions across SG&A and selected strategic initiatives. You will lead the end-to-end SG&A planning, forecasting, and budgeting cycle, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with corporate guidelines. You will develop financial models, business cases, and scenario analyses to support strategic planning and effective resource allocation. You will also contribute to long-range financial planning across the Electronics business. A key part of your role will be accelerating the use of AI and advanced analytics across FP&A, from data preparation and variance analysis to reporting automation, narrative generation, and self-service insights. Working closely with Finance, IT, and business stakeholders, you will identify, evaluate, and implement scalable AI-enabled solutions that reduce manual effort and improve decision support. You will help strengthen finance processes, reporting capabilities, and data quality so that AI-driven outputs are reliable and actionable. As a credible advocate for innovation, you will encourage the adoption of AI tools and digital ways of working across the Finance community. Throughout, you will communicate financial performance and strategic priorities clearly and transparently to stakeholders at all levels.

Who you are:

- 
You have 5 years of relevant professional experience in controlling, FP&A, accounting, or corporate finance, ideally within a large, international organization.

- 
You bring a solid understanding of financial planning, management reporting, and performance management processes, combined with strong analytical and financial modeling capabilities.

- 
You have contributed to or led finance digitalization, automation, or AI initiatives in a professional environment and are genuinely motivated to translate emerging technologies into practical Finance applications.

- 
You are proficient in finance planning and reporting systems such as TM1, SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, or Analysis for Office.

- 
You have working knowledge of AI and analytics tools used in Finance, such as Microsoft Copilot, Python for data analysis, or equivalent platforms.

- 
You have advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with automation or AI-assisted workflows in these tools is an advantage.

- 
You communicate complex financial information clearly and concisely, engage and influence senior stakeholders effectively, and work confidently in a dynamic, matrixed environment.

- 
You are solution-oriented, self-driven, detail-oriented, and collaborative, with strong interpersonal skills, a professional communication style, and fluent written and spoken English; additional languages are an asset.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Industrial Supply Chain Manager (m/w/d) (Supply-Chain-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the Job

The Industrial Supply Chain Manager (I-SCM) is responsible for managing and optimizing the manufacturing and supply chain network to ensure cost-effective, reliable, and scalable production. The role leads industrialization initiatives such as volume ramp-ups, manufacturing transfers, product changes, and supplier and factory onboardings while serving as the Supply Chain Management representative in industrialization projects.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, the I-SCM ensures that supply chain requirements are fully integrated into project execution, drives capacity and loading strategies across internal and external manufacturing sites, and supports continuous improvement initiatives to enhance supply chain performance, efficiency, and resilience.

Your Responsibilities

- Lead Volume Ramp-Up (VRU) activities, manufacturing transfers, supplier and factory onboardings, and product optimization initiatives.
- Represent Supply Chain Management (SCM) in industrialization and Product Change Notification (PCN) projects, ensuring successful implementation and alignment with business objectives.
- Design and implement efficient end-to-end supply chain concepts, including material, capacity, and financial flows across internal and external manufacturing networks.
- Drive capacity planning and loading strategies by balancing internal and external manufacturing resources, ensuring compliance with contractual commitments while optimizing cost, flexibility, capacity utilization, and service levels.
- Establish and lead cross-functional capacity and loading governance processes, including the development and maintenance of planning and loading tools.
- Analyze supply chain, inventory, demand, capacity, and supplier performance data, translating insights into actionable recommendations and management decisions.
- Develop and maintain KPIs, dashboards, and reporting tools to provide transparency, support decision-making, and monitor supply chain performance.
- Identify and drive process improvements across planning, logistics, production, and supply chain operations to enhance efficiency, visibility, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
- Support and improve system-driven processes through master data governance, data validation, process harmonization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Lead or contribute to cross-functional SCM initiatives and transformation projects, driving operational excellence and supply chain optimization.
- Proactively identify supply, capacity, and operational risks and develop mitigation plans to ensure business continuity and supply chain resilience.

Your Profile

- Master Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
- 5+ years of relevant professional experience in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Manufacturing, or a comparable industry environment.
- Experience working in project-driven and cross-functional environments; exposure to industrialization or manufacturing transfer projects is considered an advantage.
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively in international organizations.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business decisions.
- High level of ownership, independence, and decision-making capability combined with a hands-on mentality.
- Strong process orientation with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to manage complex activities in dynamic environments.
- Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office applications; experience with data analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI is an advantage.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to build trust-based relationships across all organizational levels.
- Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Core Competencies

- Supply Chain & Capacity Management
- Project & Stakeholder Management
- Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen
- Data Analytics & Performance Reporting
- Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement
- Problem Solving & Decision Making
- Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Communication & Influencing Skills
- Agile Mindset & Change Management
- Attention to Detail & Execution Excellence

jobs.description:
(Senior) Development Engineer Protection and Filtering

What you will do

- Develop next-generation discrete ESD and TVS protection devices for high-speed, RF sensitive and automotive applications.  
- Drive and execute technical work packages in product development projects, working across device design, simulation, package, technology, application requirements and product qualifications.  
- As system architect in development projects, taking ownership of product 
performance, technical concept definition and execution  
- Translate customer, application and roadmap requirements into technical product requirements for device concept, front-end technology, back-end technology, package, chip design and product performance.

- Drive and contribute to semiconductor, EM and SPICE simulations, as well as SEED-based system-level ESD analysis

- Continuously build and broaden your technical expertise and influence the 
technical direction for sustainable business success.

- Master’s degree, or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, RF Engineering, High-Speed Electronics, or a comparable field. 
- Strong understanding of semiconductor physics and devices, industrial semiconductor technologies and semiconductor product development processes. 
- Hands-on experience with TCAD tools, experience with SPICE modeling. SEED methodology and CST or comparable electromagnetic simulation tools is an advantage.  
- Knowledge of S-parameters, high-speed applications and RF/signal-integrity behavior. 
- Knowledge of common-mode filters, common-mode chokes, integrated coils, passive RF filters or integrated passive devices is highly beneficial. 
- Python programming skills and openness to using software and AI-based methods to improve engineering, simulation and data-analysis workflows. 
- Strong quality mindset and ability to balance technical performance, manufacturability, reliability and industrial production requirements. 
- Relevant professional experience in semiconductor product development, ESD/TVS protection, RF/SI, EMC or simulation is an advantage. 
- Strong team player with ownership mindset and the ability to lead cross-functional alignment, drive technical solutions forward and manage stakeholders effectively. 
- Ability to perform under change, learn continuously and grow into broader technical responsibility. 
- Fluency in English, German is a plus. 
- Very good verbal and written communication skills
